title: Corporate Grid / Compliance Through Spatial Repetition

source_refs.author: Corporate workplace and interface artifacts
source_refs.title: Open-plan offices, dashboards, compliance layouts, standardized workstations

observed_structure: people or tasks occupy repeated cells
exceptions are made visible through misalignment
the grid continues operating after individual authority exits
cinematic_affordances: one occupied cell left empty or misaligned
cultural_scope: contemporary institutional artifacts; context must specify whose compliance is being represented
transferable_structure: repeated spatial units make institutional rules visible and turn individual deviation into measurable pressure
non_transferable_surface: copying specific corporate logos, branded offices, or famous dystopian production design
